title: Memory and string-pointer lint rules (PChar, raw memory, leaks, byte counts)
summary: Eight single-file lint rules plus one widened rule: Char and temporaries cast to PChar, @S[1], read-only CreateProcess command lines, raw memory over managed types, raw-memory and handle leaks, character counts used as byte counts, Ansi APIs fed Unicode strings
intro: Read this to see what each memory and string-pointer rule reports, which ship ON and what keeps them silent.
